verdict.label: Block
verdict.headline: 1 leak must be removed before this model is trusted.
verdict.detail: Target proxy detected: cancellation_reason. Validation reads AUC 1.000 with every feature, and 0.699 without the flagged columns. That is 41.7 points of inflation.

findings.title: Target proxy detected: cancellation_reason
findings.fix: Remove cancellation_reason from training. If it is genuinely available at prediction time, prove it with an out of time evaluation.

findings.title: Row identifier used as a feature: customer_id
findings.fix: Drop customer_id before building the design matrix. Keep it only as a join key outside the model.
